slot_scores.name: protein_purchase_quantity_type
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For the protein options (chicken, salmon, tofu), are you allowed to purchase any continuous weight (for example, 150g of chicken), or must protein also be bought in discrete 100g units
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether proteins are continuous weight or discrete 100g packs, exactly matching the hidden slot's semantic rule.

slot_scores.name: min_vegetable_types_required
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are there any other constraints or preferences for tonight's dinner, such as a requirement to include at least one type of protein ... Is the requirement to include at least three different types of vegetables a hard constraint that must be strictly satisfied
slot_scores.rationale: The agent only used a vague catch-all that pointed at protein variety; the three-vegetable-types requirement was volunteered by the user simulator. The agent then followed up only on whether that volunteered requirement is hard, so it never itself elicited the minimum distinct-vegetable-type requirement.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P1 slots ended up confirmed before READY_TO_MODEL (proteins continuous via turn 1; at least three distinct vegetable types as a hard constraint via turns 3-4), and the final model reflects both, so no P0/P1 fact was left unresolved at stopping.

summary: The agent cleanly recovered the protein purchase-unit fact and correctly verified the protein-variety and vegetable-variety constraints, though the minimum-three-vegetable-types requirement was elicited mainly through a vague catch-all plus a user-volunteered fact rather than a direct question; overall the interaction resolved the material P1 facts before modeling.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
